responses.question: How many teams are in the database?
responses.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM teams;
responses.notes: Simple count over the teams table.

responses.question: Who scored the most points in basketball during the 2025-26 season?
responses.sql: SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS player, SUM(s.points) AS total_points FROM player_game_stats s JOIN games g ON g.game_id = s.game_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE g.sport = 'Basketball' AND g.season = '2025-26' GROUP BY s.player_id ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1;
responses.notes: Sums per-game points for basketball games in the 2025-26 season.

responses.question: List the top 5 basketball scorers.
responses.sql: SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS player, SUM(s.points) AS total_points FROM player_game_stats s JOIN games g ON g.game_id = s.game_id JOIN players p ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE g.sport = 'Basketball' GROUP BY s.player_id ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 5;
responses.notes: Top five by summed per-game points.

responses.question: What is Derek Foss's total passing yards?
responses.sql: SELECT SUM(s.pass_yds) AS total_passing_yards FROM player_game_stats s JOIN players p ON p.player_id = s.player_id WHERE p.first_name = 'Derek' AND p.last_name = 'Foss';
responses.notes: Sums pass_yds across all recorded games.

responses.question: Which schools have teams in both football and basketball?
responses.sql: SELECT school FROM teams GROUP BY school HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sport) = 2 ORDER BY school;
responses.notes: Groups teams by school and requires both sports present.

responses.question: Who had the most rebounds in a single game?
responses.sql: SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS player, s.rebounds FROM player_game_stats s JOIN players p ON p.player_id = s.player_id JOIN games g ON g.game_id = s.game_id ORDER BY s.rebounds DESC LIMIT 1;
responses.notes: Single-game maximum of the rebounds column.

responses.question: What was the highest scoring football game?
responses.sql: SELECT game_id, game_date, home_score + away_score AS total_points FROM games WHERE sport = 'Football' ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1;
responses.notes: Orders football games by combined score.

responses.question: What was Marcus Bell's average points per game this season?

responses.notes: Uses the pre-aggregated season totals table for efficiency.

responses.question: How many games did Jackson Prep win in the 2025 football season?
responses.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS wins FROM games g JOIN teams t ON (t.team_id = g.home_team_id AND g.home_score > g.away_score) OR (t.team_id = g.away_team_id AND g.away_score > g.home_score) WHERE t.school = 'Jackson Prep' AND t.sport = 'Football' AND g.season = '2025';
responses.notes: Counts games where Jackson Prep's score was higher.

responses.question: How many points did Jackson score this season?
responses.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.home_team_id = t.team_id THEN g.home_score ELSE g.away_score END) AS total_points FROM games g JOIN teams t ON t.team_id IN (g.home_team_id, g.away_team_id) WHERE t.school = 'Jackson Prep' AND t.sport = 'Football';
responses.notes: Interpreted 'Jackson' as the Jackson Prep football team.

responses.question: How many injuries were reported for Riverside this season?
responses.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS injury_count FROM injuries i JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = i.team_id WHERE t.school = 'Riverside';
responses.notes: Counts rows in the injuries table for the team.

responses.question: Did Riverside beat Oak Hill this season?
responses.sql: SELECT g.game_date, g.home_score, g.away_score FROM games g JOIN teams h ON h.team_id = g.home_team_id JOIN teams a ON a.team_id = g.away_team_id WHERE h.school = 'Riverside AND a.school = 'Oak Hill';
responses.notes: Fetches head-to-head results between the two schools.
